commits.message:
Remove BookMapper and update mapping logic

Deleted BookMapper interface and removed MapStruct dependencies from the project. Updated CatalogManagement class to use the static from method in BookDto for converting CatalogBook instances to DTOs.

commits.author: xsreality
commits.message:
Simplify checkout workflow

Replaced CheckoutDto with HoldInformation to streamline data handling during the checkout process. Updated related methods, tests, and controller to reflect the new structure and included hold status in the response.

commits.message: Upgraded Spring Boot to 3.3.3, MapStruct to 1.6.0, and Spring Modulith BOM to 1.2.3.

commits.author: Abhinav Sonkar
commits.message:
Simplify hexagonal implementation for borrow BC (#27)

* Simplify hexagonal implementation for borrow BC

* Remove HoldEventPublisher and Refactor Event Handling

Removed the HoldEventPublisher class and refactored event handling to use domain events directly within entity methods. Updated CirculationDesk and Hold classes accordingly to maintain event-driven logic. Adjusted tests and other dependent classes to match the new event handling approach.
